subject.title: fix(ui): show workspace context in dashboard header

question: Should the multi-agent workspace context live in the current topbar/breadcrumb header, or should maintainers replace that surface with a different persistent context UI before this PR is ported?
rationale: Current main refactored the header shell after this PR's base, and another open maintainer UI PR proposes removing the breadcrumb direction, so automation cannot safely choose the product surface to preserve.

options.title: Port focused breadcrumb
options.body: Keep the linked issue's focused slice, rebase this PR, and move the workspace-label plumbing and tests onto the current app shell/header paths.

options.title: Pause for header redesign
options.body: Leave this PR open until the competing no-breadcrumb/topbar direction is accepted or rejected, then ask for a targeted rebase or replacement.

options.title: Close for fresh implementation
options.body: If maintainers no longer want breadcrumb context, close this stale branch and request a new PR against the approved persistent-context surface.

recommendation.title: Port focused breadcrumb
recommendation.body: Keep the linked issue's focused slice, rebase this PR, and move the workspace-label plumbing and tests onto the current app shell/header paths.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the current dashboard chrome redesign and are the strongest current-main owner for the header product direction.
